limits: Allow-list of nine exact hosts (Bank of Canada, Federal Reserve Board, Statistics Canada x2, SEC x2, Wikimedia, iShares, GDELT). The agent repeatedly tried issuer and company sites (BlackRock, BMO ETFs, JPMorgan, SSGA, Microsoft); each was refused in about a millisecond and left an evidence gap.
A start URL is required: web.browse cannot search; it reads a page the agent already knows.
Links are followed only when their text or path contains a task word (4+ letters, no stemming); fragile across languages and synonyms.
PDF and other non-HTML documents are skipped; many official releases are PDFs.
Up to 5 pages, 12 s per page, 36 s per call; a session is opened per call. Event briefs with research take about 80-90 s instead of about 40 s.
An unknown HTTP status (0) is accepted as a page.
Cookie banners are not dismissed; their text can be captured.
Cache is in process memory, per Lambda instance, one day.
Worker reserved concurrency is 2: a third concurrent analysis waited and was failed by the watchdog after 61 s (run_01M7G2MYP15T0M9XX5S2Q14QBF on version 9).
SEC (EDGAR) answered source_unavailable and etf.holdings has no issuer file configured, so those research tools add calls but no evidence.
